_note: Recorded quality ceilings mined from the green-loop campaign ledger (.claude/green-loop/state.md). Each entry pins a (catalogId, step[, entityId]) cell to the KIND of wall that caps its judge score, so the capability lens can tell 'our technique can't do better' apart from 'this project's data is locked/unseeded' and 'a checker forces the number the judge then flags'. project-data + checker-structural cells are EXCLUDED from a capability class's median (they don't measure technique); technique cells stay IN and CAP the class. When a cause is ambiguous it is classified 'technique' (conservative — counts against our capability, never inflates it). This is a READ-ONLY lens; it never touches statusModel grading or any gate.

ceilings.note: arithmeticReconciles + withinPercent forces the drop numbers into the exact band the judge then calls target-fitting (~62) — the checker, not the technique, sets the wall.
pricePowerRatio checker forces the price↔power reconciliation the adversarial judge re-flags as fitted-to-target rather than designed.
Sunderlight locked baseValue 15 at ilvl70/req57 reads as a low-tier-vs-high-ilvl contradiction; the number is a locked seed, not a content defect.
Compare target 'Duelist's Edge' exists only in-brief — no seeded sibling row for the judge to weigh against (unseeded upstream).
Vendor-laws margin band vs faction-rep discount is a canon-vs-canon collision; the cap is an unresolved owner-canon decision, not writing quality.
item-3/4/5 + dangling item-7 upstream base rows are seed-scarce; the link step can only cite the roster that exists (unseeded upstream).
Systems-spec adversarial-escalation ceiling ~72-82: the strict judge escalates polish demands each round; leaner-airtight beats ever-deeper but a wall remains.
Deliberately-low 38-DPS spine makes the Unique read 'thin / strictly worse outside boss armour' to an adversarial judge — a craft/framing wall, not the locked number itself.
Searing Cut 100% armour-negation vs canon soft-cap is a plausibility coin-flip the judge re-flags even with an explicit max-penetration value-zero law.
Config-artifact craft-depth ceiling ~88-89: the judge's polish bar for competent-but-not-quite-shippable systems prose; settle med-3 twice and stop.
Craft-depth 86-89 wall on config artifacts — breadth dilutes, and the adversarial judge caps otherwise-correct UI/config specs short of shippable.
Judge mis-computes WCAG luminance (an arithmetic coin-flip) and caps otherwise-correct a11y specs — a judge-arithmetic technique wall.
Ignite rate-continuity is an arithmetic coin-flip: the judge re-flags a correct DoT rate as discontinuous — judge-arithmetic technique ceiling.

The judge argues the L90-99 cost clamp flattens the curve exactly where PoE2/LE steepen it (70.4 h to L100 reads short for a 100-level ARPG). The clamp is the entity's authored soft-cap model, canon-cited to ARPG-LAWS section 9; changing it re-derives every minute and hour figure in the entity. A design decision for the owner, not a writing defect.

45.0 minutes held flat across 53 levels (L32-84) is a flatness no shipped ARPG in the reference set runs. The flatness is the model's deliberate thesis and is proven algebraically; the judge disputes the design choice, not the derivation. Re-tuning the beat is an owner decision.
